scenarios.request: What is the weather like in London today?
scenarios.pass_criteria: Temperature within 2 deg C of the Open-Meteo reference taken within 10 min; London named or clearly implied; 25 words or fewer; no markdown; no image.
scenarios.manual: Whether the answer matches the Open-Meteo reference, and its format.

scenarios.request: What's the Bitcoin price in euros right now?
scenarios.pass_criteria: Price within 2 % of the reference taken within 5 min; currency is EUR; states it is a live value; 25 words or fewer.
scenarios.manual: Whether the price is within 2 % of the reference (Coinbase), and its format.

scenarios.pointing: 1 zone: the building in the photo
scenarios.pass_criteria: Brandenburg Gate / Brandenburger Tor named; city Berlin; max 25 words; exactly one image at the top of the answer and it loads.

needs.why: the Tavily Search API behind the image MCP

scenarios.manual: That the model names the Brandenburg Gate, and the one picture at the top of the answer.

scenarios.request: Which of these three is best for a five kilometre road run? Compare them and recommend one.
scenarios.pointing: 3 zones: the three shoe cards, left to right
scenarios.pass_criteria: Recommends Aero Racer 2; at least two of weight / price / type compared with correct numbers from the page; Trail Grip X not recommended for road; exactly one image; 25 words or fewer (comparison may use up to 250 only if asked).

needs.why: the Tavily Search API behind the image MCP

scenarios.manual: The recommendation, and the one product picture.

checks.label: compares at least two correct numbers from the page
30 words or fewer (workbook says 25; allowed 30 because the replay has no tools and no zone crop)

replay.not_replayed: The tool call for the product picture and the 'exactly one image' rule (no tools are offered to the model in a replay).

scenarios.request: Fill this form with the name Max Mustermann, email max.mustermann@example.com, phone plus 49 30 1234567, company Muster GmbH and country Germany.
scenarios.pass_criteria: All five fields hold exactly the spoken values (email and phone character-exact, select shows Germany); no submit ('Thank you' text absent); finished within the run.
scenarios.manual: That the Maverick Chrome extension is running on the device and fills the five fields exactly.

scenarios.request: Open the web browser and go to amazon.com.
scenarios.pass_criteria: Chrome shows amazon.com (or the .com landing page) within 15 s of the send; the assistant confirms; no extra tab left blank.
scenarios.manual: That the extension opens amazon.com within 15 s.

scenarios.request: Generate an image of a cat in an astronaut costume in open space.
scenarios.pass_criteria: Image file exists; clearly a cat, a space suit and a space background; no text artefacts; the modality is not asked because 'image' is named.
scenarios.manual: The generated picture and that it opens.

scenarios.pass_criteria: Status line shows a rising percentage; a new .glb appears in the file list (GET /files); answer says it was sent to the SRD (sent_count >= 1) or states why not; no clarification asked.
scenarios.manual: Generation progress, the .glb in storage and that the SRD shows it (The SRD (3D display) itself and its controller registration; the suite only sees mav-starkit-api and device mapping.)

scenarios.request: Show me this sneaker. On three d monitor.
scenarios.pass_criteria: No progress percentage and no new file in storage; SRD shows the trail shoe; answer says it was loaded from storage. Real baseline ~19 s - flag anything over 30 s.
scenarios.manual: Loading from storage and that the SRD shows it (The SRD (3D display) itself and its controller registration; the suite only sees mav-starkit-api and device mapping.)

scenarios.request: Make a video of this sneaker rotating slowly on a white background.
scenarios.pass_criteria: Progress percentage shown; MP4 stored with the 'stereo-video' marker; if no stereo video is produced the tool fails with a clear message (3D-010); normal status text returns afterwards (3D-008).
scenarios.manual: Progress, the stereo-video marker and the SRD (The SRD (3D display) itself and its controller registration; the suite only sees mav-starkit-api and device mapping.)

scenarios.request: Show me the three d video of dancing cats.
scenarios.pass_criteria: No progress percentage and no new file in storage; video reaches the SRD (sent_count >= 1); it is the existing file with the 'stereo-video' marker; answer says it was loaded from storage; never starts a new generation. If the library has no cats video the run is invalid - run GS-08.1 first.
scenarios.expected_tools: ImageToVideoAgent: existing-video lookup, send_file_to_srd (tool names as in GS-08.1; lookup step not verified)
scenarios.manual: Loading from storage and the SRD (The SRD (3D display) itself and its controller registration; the suite only sees mav-starkit-api and device mapping.)

scenarios.pass_criteria: Meaning complete: two working days, part of the order missing, will notify when shipped; fluent English; no German left over; may exceed 25 words because a translation is the content.

checks.label: says the delivery is delayed by two working days
says part of the order is missing or not yet in stock
says they will notify when it ships

replay.not_replayed: That the model translated the pointed block (the left one) and not the other two.

scenarios.pass_criteria: Direction (up) correct; Q1 1.2 and Q4 2.6 correct; no wrong value; 25 words or fewer.

checks.label: no wrong chart value (a decimal that is not 1.2, 1.5, 1.9, 2.6 or a difference of two of them; percentages and integers are ignored)

replay.not_replayed: That the model looked at the bar chart and not at the region table (pointing).
